program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (filled-rect? obj)
      (= (obj-size obj) (* (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))])
      (if (and (filled-rect? obj) (>= (obj-h obj) 2) (>= (obj-w obj) 2))
          (paint-cells out (list (list (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj)) (list (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c2 obj)) (list (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c1 obj)) (list (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj))) 2)
          out))))
